content:
Goal
* Please format all the possible output phrases as {{constants}} (separately, excluding the commas), and remove all the quotation marks.

* Please explain how the player should determine the triangle type.

Constraints
* Please change 100 to 10, as the input values never exceed 10.

Cases
* Please restore the original case names (Test 1, Validator 1, etc).

* Please revise the cases so that each pair covers one of the output phrases. There should be at least 4 case pairs in total.

* When designing the cases, please use random input values so that a ≤ b ≤ c doesn't always hold.

Thanks.
